night_start.name: Me
night_start.text: *Back in my room. Lying on the bed.*

night_start_2.name: Me
night_start_2.text: *For a first day — I'm drained. But it's not bad.*

night_msg_seo_3.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
night_msg_seo_3.text: *Next time I'll at least have drinks ready*

night_msg_seo_5.name: Me
night_msg_seo_5.text: *She sent 'It's on the house' as a separate message on purpose. — Is this calculated, or sincere?*

night_msg_yuna_3.name: Me
night_msg_yuna_3.text: *Short. But 'I'll save your seat' — for her, isn't that the warmest welcome she can give?*

night_msg_dain_3.name: 다인(Dain)
night_msg_dain_3.text: *Still salty about the bread money honestly lolol*

night_msg_dain_4.name: Me
night_msg_dain_4.text: *Three messages in a row. Can she not breathe between texts?*

night_late_transition.name: Me
night_late_transition.text: *About to fall asleep when — my phone buzzes one more time.*

night_seo_late_1.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
night_seo_late_1.text: *Want to walk to school together tomorrow?*

night_seo_late_2.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
night_seo_late_2.text: *I'll wait in front of your house*

night_seo_late_3.name: Me
night_seo_late_3.text: *...What? The student council president, in front of my house? — My heart skips a beat. Why.*

night_yuna_late_4.name: Me
night_yuna_late_4.text: *She said 'that's all,' but it doesn't feel like that's all.*

night_dain_late_4.name: Me
night_dain_late_4.text: *Does this person not understand the concept of 'no'?*

night_end_2.name: Me
night_end_2.text: *Staring at the ceiling. The cherry blossom scent still lingers on my uniform.*
